propositions: Completion verifier returns a Dep record (containing relation and target_id) where a CompletionVerdict schema object is required, causing validation failure and fail-closed close refusal.

The structured output parser selects the first parseable JSON object (schema-blind) rather than the first object satisfying the target schema, when quoted dependency records precede the valid verdict in the model's freetext output.
The show_ticket tool result includes raw JSON deps in the verifier's assembled context, which the model quotes in prose before stating the verdict, triggering selection priority inversion.

Root cause is deterministic and reproducible: the same reply with the quoted dep record removed parses correctly to a valid CompletionVerdict, proving the model output is sound and only selection is defective.

Schema-filtered candidate selection in parse_structured must screen candidates by key-overlap against model_cls.model_fields, validate each survivor, and select the last valid candidate (not first parseable) to recover all five historical recurrence layouts.
